template.tagline: Light the motor, coast past 100 km, come home.
template.brief: One solid motor, fins for stability and a small science box. There is nothing to throttle and nothing to stage: the motor burns out in seconds and the rocket coasts up past the 100 km line that is commonly used as the edge of space. It is the simplest design that can do it.

benchmark.text: Sounding rockets are short research flights: up, a few minutes of data or weightlessness, then down. Many are simple solid motors with fins. 100 km is the altitude commonly used as the boundary of space.
